Full specification sheet

REV 1.5 · SKU RPI4-MODB · Official product page ↗
CPU
Broadcom BCM2711, quad-core Cortex-A72 (ARM v8-A) 64-bit SoC @ 1.5GHz, 28nm process.
GPU
VideoCore VI, OpenGL ES 3.1 & Vulkan 1.0, HEVC decode at 4Kp60.
Memory
2GB / 4GB / 8GB LPDDR4-3200 SDRAM, shared with GPU.
Storage
microSD slot for OS and data, with USB and network boot support.
Networking
Gigabit Ethernet (true native, not USB-bridged), dual-band 802.11ac Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0 / BLE.
Video Out
Dual micro-HDMI, independent 4K displays — 4Kp60 on one port, 4Kp30 on both simultaneously.
USB
2 × USB 3.0 (5Gbps SuperSpeed), 2 × USB 2.0 (480Mbps), all Type-A.
Camera & Display
2-lane MIPI CSI-2 camera connector, MIPI DSI display connector.
GPIO
Standard 40-pin header, 2.54mm pitch, 27 GPIO with UART, SPI, I²C and PWM.
Audio
4-pole 3.5mm jack — composite video plus stereo analogue audio.
Power
USB-C, 5V / 3A, with 4-pin PoE header for the official PoE HAT.
Dimensions
PCB 85 × 56 × 1.2mm, ∼17mm overall with connectors, ∼46g.
